title: The pipeline is restructured for simplicity and flexibility
body: The search pipeline in `nail/src/pipeline/` and the alignment loop in `nail/src/search.rs` are to be restructured for simplicity and for more flexibility in what a stage can do with its results. Jack asked for this issue on 2026-11-02 while rejecting two designs for per-query sorting of `results.tbl` on nail-06b3e4; both needed more machinery than the current output stage should carry. No design work has been done yet. This is future work.
